validated_targets.experimental_detail: mTOR inhibitor treatment in KRAS PTEN mouse model of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma resulted in proliferative arrest and tumor regression, demonstrating mTOR dependency.

title: Targeting mTOR dependency in pancreatic cancer.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Rapid depletion of KLF5 using dTAG technology decreased cell viability and induced apoptosis; enhancer inactivation via KRAB-dCas9 confirmed KLF5-bound enhancers control target genes including BCL2L1.
Overexpression of Bcl-xL rescued apoptosis after KLF5 depletion; multiplex immunofluorescence confirmed KLF5 and Bcl-xL co-staining in PDAC patient samples.

title: KLF5 controls subtype-independent highly interactive enhancers in pancreatic cancer to regulate cell survival.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: FOSL2 overexpression promoted PDAC cell proliferation, migration, and invasion; functional assays including CCK8, transwell, and xenograft models confirmed its tumor-promoting role. It was identified as a downstream target of KRAS/MAPK pathway and recruited Treg cells by binding CCL28 promoter.

FOSL2 directly bound CCL28 promoter and transcriptionally activated CCL28 as shown by ChIP-qPCR and dual-luciferase reporter; upregulated CCL28 recruited regulatory T cells, promoting immunosuppressive microenvironment.

title: Chromatin accessibility uncovers KRAS-driven FOSL2 promoting pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma progression through up-regulation of CCL28.

evidence_summary: CRISPR-mediated deletion of individual iHUB enhancers and JunD depletion decreased target gene transcription and chemoresistance; small molecule inhibitors of upstream pathways restored chemotherapy responsiveness in vitro and in vivo.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: JunD depletion decreased iHUB interaction frequency and transcription of target genes in resistant PDAC models.

title: Interactive enhancer hubs (iHUBs) mediate transcriptional reprogramming and adaptive resistance in pancreatic cancer.

evidence_summary: Fructose treatment in PDAC cells under glucose-deficient conditions maintained survival, proliferation, and invasion; GLUT5-mediated metabolism shown in vivo and in vitro; fructose activated AMPK-mTORC1 signaling to inhibit autophagy; clinical samples showed high GLUT5 expression as independent marker.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: GLUT5-mediated fructose metabolism maintained survival, proliferation, and invasion capacities of PDAC cells in vivo and in vitro; high expression in PDAC tissues is an independent marker of disease progression.
Fructose activated AMPK-mTORC1 signaling to inhibit glucose deficiency-induced autophagic cell death, promoting PDAC progression.

title: Fructose-Induced mTORC1 Activation Promotes Pancreatic Cancer Progression through Inhibition of Autophagy.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: FGFR4 depletion in PDAC cells led to increased proliferation and mTORC1 pathway hyperactivation in vitro and in vivo, and enrichment of basal-like/squamous gene programs.

title: Loss of FGFR4 promotes the malignant phenotype of PDAC.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Conditional ablation of p130Cas in Kras-driven PDAC mouse model inhibited tumor development and extended median survival; high p130Cas expression in human PDAC correlated with higher histological grade and poor prognosis.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: KrasG12D murine pancreatic cancer models, human PDAC samples

Autophagy Sustains Pancreatic Cancer Growth through Both Cell-Autonomous and Nonautonomous Mechanisms.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: SERPINB3 overexpression enhanced in vitro invasion and promoted lung metastasis in a mouse xenograft model; inhibited calpain to activate MYC.
SERPINB3 inhibited calpain leading to MYC activation, which drove basal-like/squamous subtype and metabolic reprogramming.

title: SERPINB3-MYC axis induces the basal-like/squamous subtype and enhances disease progression in pancreatic cancer.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Genetic or pharmacologic depletion of EZH2 increased GATA6 expression and induced a gene signature shift toward a less aggressive classical subtype.
Abrogation of GATA6 expression in EZH2-deficient PDAC cells counteracted the acquisition of classical gene signatures and rescued invasive capacities.

title: EZH2 Regulates Pancreatic Cancer Subtype Identity and Tumor Progression via Transcriptional Repression of GATA6.

evidence_summary: SerpinB2 knockout mouse embryonic fibroblasts co-injected with pancreatic cancer cells in an allograft model led to increased tumor growth, aberrant ECM remodeling and enhanced local invasion, accompanied by elevated uPA proteolytic activity.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Co-injection of SerpinB2-/- MEFs with PDAC cells in allograft model increased tumor growth, aberrant ECM remodelling and local invasion; elevated uPA activity was detected.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: mouse embryonic fibroblasts (MEFs), pancreatic cancer allograft model

title: SerpinB2 regulates stromal remodelling and local invasion in pancreatic cancer.

title: Suppression of pancreatic cancer liver metastasis by secretion-deficient ITIH5.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Knockdown of BACH1 in PDAC cell lines reduced cell migration and invasion, increased E-cadherin; overexpression had opposite effects; BACH1 directly repressed FOXA1, CLDN3, CLDN4; in mouse orthotopic AsPC-1 model BACH1 was required for high metastasis; IHC showed high BACH1 is a poor prognostic factor.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: PDAC cell lines, AsPC-1 cells, clinical specimens

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Cldn18.2 knockout mouse models and PC18.1 peptide disrupted CLDN18.2/β-catenin interaction, inhibiting PDAC progression and sensitizing immunotherapy.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: KPC mouse model, Cldn18.2 knockout, patient-derived xenograft/organoid

title: Trogocytosis-orchestrated CLDN18.2-"dressed" CD8<sup>+</sup> T cells drive pancreatic cancer progression via glucose metabolic reprogramming-induced cytotoxicity debilitation and systematic immune senescence cascade.

evidence_summary: Pharmacological inhibition of PI3Kδ reduced collagen deposition and enhanced CD8+ T cell infiltration in PDAC models, and co-inhibition of autotaxin further amplified stromal disruption and improved chemo-immunotherapy efficacy.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Pharmacological inhibition of PI3Kδ reduces collagen deposition and enhances CD8+ T cell infiltration, reprogramming the tumor microenvironment; PI3Kδ regulates LPA biosynthesis.
Co-inhibition of autotaxin with PI3Kδ amplifies stromal disruption and improves chemo-immunotherapy efficacy in preclinical PDAC models.

title: Targeting PI3Kδ suppresses pancreatic cancer by dual disruption of fibrosis and immune evasion.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Autotaxin inhibition with IOA-289 suppressed NFκB activation and overcame adaptive resistance to TGFβ inhibitor galunisertib and gemcitabine in PDAC cells, and synergized with galunisertib in orthotopic murine models; increased plasma autotaxin upon galunisertib treatment correlated with shorter PFS in patients.

title: Autotaxin Secretion Is a Stromal Mechanism of Adaptive Resistance to TGFβ Inhibition in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma.

evidence_summary: Pharmacological inhibition (CAY10526), siRNA knockdown, and CRISPR knockout of PTGES in PANC-1 and BxPC-3 cells impaired Schwann cell directional migration and neurite outgrowth toward pancreatic cancer cells in 3D coculture models, confirming PTGES/PGE2-driven Schwann cell dedifferentiation and perineural invasion.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: PTGES inhibitor (CAY10526), siPTGES, or PTGES-KO impaired directional migration and neurite outgrowth of Schwann cells toward PDAC cells in 3D coculture models, and PGE2 stimulation elevated dedifferentiation markers p75NTR, c-Jun, SOX2, and GDNF.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: PANC-1, BxPC-3

title: Prostaglandin E<sub>2</sub>-driven dedifferentiation of Schwann cells leads to perineural invasion in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.

evidence_summary: In PDAC cells and Mir15a knockout mouse model, Fra-2 and IGF1R were upregulated under nutrient restriction; IGF1R inhibition suppressed tumor growth in a Fra-2-dependent manner.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Fra-2 was identified as a miR-15a target mediating adaptive response to nutrient deprivation; upregulated in miR-15a-low PDAC patients and Mir15a KO mice under diet restriction, promoting mTOR activation and tumor growth.

IGF1R overexpression observed in miR-15a-downmodulated PDAC; its inhibition under nutrient restriction reduced tumor growth in a Fra-2-dependent manner, with enhanced efficacy in diet-restricted conditions.

title: Nutrient restriction-activated Fra-2 promotes tumor progression via IGF1R in miR-15a downmodulated pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.

evidence_summary: Knockdown/knockout of SLC3A2 or B3GNT3, or blocking N-glycosylation with tunicamycin, sensitized PDAC cells to ferroptosis; reconstitution with wild-type but not glycosylation-mutant 4F2hc restored resistance; orthotopic model confirmed enhanced ferroptosis-induced tumor inhibition.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Knockdown of SLC3A2 sensitized PDAC cells to ferroptosis, impaired system Xc- activity and decreased intracellular glutathione; genetic perturbation augmented ferroptosis-induced inhibition of orthotopic PDAC.
Knockout of B3GNT3 or deletion of enzymatically active B3GNT3 sensitized PDAC cells to ferroptosis; high expression of B3GNT3 contributes to progression and poor survival.

title: Targeting N-glycosylation of 4F2hc mediated by glycosyltransferase B3GNT3 sensitizes ferroptosis of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.

evidence_summary: CTCF was upregulated in PDAC; its interaction with HNRNPU via FLG-AS1 recruited EP300 and activated IGF2BP2, promoting proliferation; curaxin combined with gemcitabine treatment showed antitumor efficacy in PDAC models.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: CTCF interacts with HNRNPU through FLG-AS1 to recruit EP300 and activate IGF2BP2, stimulating PDAC cell proliferation; its inhibition by curaxin combined with gemcitabine suppresses tumor progression.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: PDAC cells, mouse model (unspecified)

title: CTCF enhances pancreatic cancer progression via FLG-AS1-dependent epigenetic regulation and macrophage polarization.

evidence_summary: Functional experiments demonstrated CSTF2 suppresses anti-tumor immunity by inhibiting innate αβ T cell infiltration through APA-mediated CXCL10 downregulation; Forsythoside B inhibition of CSTF2 activated anti-tumor immunity and overcame ICB resistance in PDAC.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: CSTF2 promoted tumor immune evasion by reducing CXCL10 expression through enhanced PAPα binding, shortening polyA tails; its inhibition with Forsythoside B reversed immune evasion and enhanced ICB efficacy.

title: CSTF2-impeded innate αβ T cell infiltration and activation exacerbate immune evasion of pancreatic cancer.

evidence_summary: SIRT7 O-GlcNAcylation at serine 136 stabilizes SIRT7 by blocking REGγ-mediated degradation; in vitro and in vivo experiments show blocking this modification attenuates pancreatic cancer progression.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Blocking SIRT7 O-GlcNAcylation at S136 by site-directed mutagenesis reduced protein stability and attenuated tumor progression in pancreatic cancer cell lines and animal models.

title: O-GlcNAcylation and stablization of SIRT7 promote pancreatic cancer progression by blocking the SIRT7-REGγ interaction.

evidence_summary: ROR1 depletion suppresses tumor growth, recurrence, and metastasis; targeting YAP/BRD4 pathway reduces ROR1 expression and prevents PDAC growth.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: ROR1 depletion suppresses tumor growth, recurrence after chemotherapy, and metastasis; ROR1 induces AURKB via c-Myc/E2F to enhance proliferation.
Targeting the YAP/BRD4 transcriptional control at the ROR1 enhancer reduces ROR1 expression and prevents PDAC growth.

title: YAP/BRD4-controlled ROR1 promotes tumor-initiating cells and hyperproliferation in pancreatic cancer.

evidence_summary: In vivo metastatic model identified SENP3 as a suppressor of PDAC metastasis; mechanistic studies showed SENP3 deSUMOylates DKC1, reducing DKC1 stability and disrupting snoRNP interactions to impair migration; DKC1 overexpression rescued metastasis and was elevated in patient specimens.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: SENP3 inhibited PDAC invasion in a SUMO-dependent manner in an in vivo metastatic model; it interacted with DKC1 and catalyzed its deSUMOylation, leading to DKC1 instability and impaired migration.
Overexpression of DKC1 abated the anti-metastasis effect of SENP3; DKC1 was elevated in PDAC specimens and associated with poor prognosis.

title: SUMO specific peptidase 3 halts pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma metastasis via deSUMOylating DKC1.

evidence_summary: In Gpr34ΔLyz2 mouse models and in vitro co-cultures, GPR34+ macrophages released LysoPS to enhance CXCL16 secretion and efferocytosis, leading to MHC-I degradation and CD8+ T cell exhaustion; a GPR34 antagonist combined with chemotherapy and surufatinib significantly enhanced anti-tumor responses in preclinical models.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Gpr34 conditional knockout in myeloid cells and GPR34 antagonist treatment inhibited MHC-I degradation, reduced CD8+ T cell exhaustion, and enhanced anti-tumor immunity in preclinical models.
validated_targets.specific_model_name: Gpr34ΔLyz2 mice, in vitro macrophage-T cell co-cultures, preclinical tumor models

title: Targeting GPR34 in damage-associated macrophages enhances anti-tumor immunity and the efficacy of Surufatinib in pancreatic cancer.

evidence_summary: Prrx1 isoform switching regulates EMT/MET plasticity in PDAC; Prrx1b promotes invasion and EMT, Prrx1a drives metastatic colonization and MET; HGF is a transcriptional target of Prrx1b, and combined HGF-targeted therapy with gemcitabine reduces primary tumor volume and eliminates metastasis in a preclinical model.

validated_targets.experimental_detail: Prrx1b promotes invasion, tumor dedifferentiation, and EMT; Prrx1a stimulates metastatic outgrowth in the liver, tumor differentiation, and MET in PDAC models.

HGF identified as a transcriptional target of Prrx1b; targeted therapy of HGF in combination with gemcitabine in a preclinical PDAC model reduces primary tumor volume and eliminates metastatic disease.

title: Prrx1 isoform switching regulates pancreatic cancer invasion and metastatic colonization.

evidence_summary: STAMBP knockdown in PDAC cells suppressed proliferation and migration, and inhibited xenograft tumor growth; STAMBP deubiquitinates BAG3 at K29 and K60, stabilizing it; STAMBP deficiency increased cisplatin/oxaliplatin sensitivity.
